correctness.rationale: A complete homogeneous-coordinate and independent affine-coordinate construction yields the same 13 four-point lines. Exhaustive enumeration of all 8192 labeled binary assignments yields 468 valid colorings. Flip edges constructed by 13 coordinate toggles equal an independently built pairwise Hamming-one adjacency. Full breadth-first search from each of 468 sources checks each of 219024 ordered pairs, establishes full connectivity, radii and diameter 13, and finds exactly 166608 pairs with graph distance equal to Hamming distance and 52416 with distance exactly Hamming+2; each source has 112 detour targets. Standalone checker was replayed from actual source and produced the included output. BFS on finite unweighted graphs is exact; no extrapolation is made.

originality.rationale: The contribution is strictly the coordinate-sensitive all-pairs metric and detour census; known static semioval size-six classification and potentially covered abstract F468 parameters are excluded. Targeted source/alias/implication database searches, an accessible literature-led corpus, and available own historical claims show no equivalent or dominating 13-bit metric theorem. The highest-risk matching abstract cubic graph F468 is explicitly compared; its graph catalog alone does not imply a distinguished Hamming embedding. Remaining source-access and unindexed-geometry risks are documented.
residual_risks: F468 may be isomorphic to the current flip graph; an earlier explicit geometry realization with Hamming coordinates could contain the claimed 112-target metric distribution, despite the catalog's lack of that data.
The full article of Anastos–Frieze (2020) was unavailable, though its published theorem domain is random hypergraphs and not this finite plane.
Unindexed theses, code repositories or older combinatorial tables could reproduce this precise coordinate-sensitive census.

value.rationale: The projective-plane line hypergraph of order three is a natural minimal two-colorable geometric design. Its 468 legal two-colorings form a constrained state space, and the exact 0-or-2 excess over Hamming distance quantitatively distinguishes reachability, geodesic optimality, and forced temporary point recolorings. The nontrivial sharp count 112 of 467 other states per configuration has direct reconfiguration and Glauber-state-geometry meaning, rather than being an arbitrary numerical parameter; an abstract 468-node graph diameter alone cannot supply it.
